title: Quirk Applause Gate
purpose: Evaluate claimed wins by separating visible signal, causal support, guardrails, evidence integrity, and authority before success language hardens.

when_to_use: Use when a claimed success needs bounded evidence diagnosis before celebration, rollout, publication, or promotion.
when_not_to_use: Do not use when the evidence set cannot be identified or when a consequential action is being requested without a separate authority grant.

sequence: Resolve the candidate, claim, evidence references, comparison, guardrails, and evaluated version.
Classify using only supplied request content and preserve contradictions or integrity failures.
Emit a schema-valid review with authority_effect none and a reversible next move.
Stop before any rollout, publication, runtime activation, admission, or irreversible action.
decision_points: Does supplied evidence justify signal-only, bounded diagnosis, verified success, false positive, unresolved, or integrity failure?
Would the next action exceed infer authority or convert evidence into execution permission?
approval_gates: External human admission is required before runtime loading.
A separate scoped grant is required for every consequential execution.
